title: 3rd Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/3/1/2026).
Approval of the minutes of two previous special sittings (minutes Nos. 20/2026/ޚޞ/1 to 20/2026/ޚޞ/2).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act (Law No. 20/2021) for appointing non-resident ambassadors of the Maldives to foreign countries is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission for appointing a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to Oman is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission for appointing a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to the Republic of Armenia is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Preliminary debate on the Bill to amend the Anti-Terrorism Act (Law No. 32/2015), submitted by North Galolhu MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
Preliminary debate on the National Service Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by South Kulhudhuffushi MP Faruhath Mohamed.

Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's request for the Majlis's consent for the Maldives to join the Labour Centre of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation and to sign and ratify its statute.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to approve special-sitting minutes, send three ambassador nominations to committee, begin debate on an Anti-Terrorism Act amendment and the National Service Bill, and take up a report on joining the OIC Labour Centre.
